shell.init_hook: echo '🚀 Initializing PPA Django Reuse development environment...' && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt -r dev-requirements.txt && npm install && echo '✅ Environment ready! Run: devbox run setup'

scripts.setup: echo '📦 Setting up services and database...' && bash scripts/kill_port.sh 8000 && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && sleep 5 && bash scripts/setup.sh
scripts.setup:quick: echo '⚡ Quick setup (skip Solr)...' && bash scripts/kill_port.sh 8000 && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py setup_site_pages && python manage.py shell -c "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model; User = get_user_model(); User.objects.create_superuser('admin', 'admin@example.com', 'admin123') if not User.objects.filter(username='admin').exists() else None" && echo '✅ Quick setup complete! Run: devbox run dev'
scripts.clean: bash scripts/kill_port.sh 8000 && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && rm -rf .venv node_modules static/js static/css
